title: Frontend Engineer — Learning Platforms
abolSummaryText: Frontend Engineer — Learning Platforms is a full-time role with Abol Learn Studio in Lagos, Nigeria. Pay is 32,000–48,000 USD per year; apply by 1 February 2027.
description:
Build calm, accessible learning surfaces with React and Abol Kit embeds.

You will:
- Own the Learn hub UI and theme job notices with host CSS variables
- Keep mobile paths crisp and keyboard-friendly
- Integrate caption and audio-summary APIs without inventing undocumented attributes

Nice to have: React 19 custom-element experience and an eye for typography.
